description: The rider's rides, newest first: id, local start, duration, kJ, average and max power, average and max heart rate, kind (free, ramp, rampLite, edge, workout), the rider's effort rating (1-10, null if not rated). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the rider's local time, both inclusive. limit: 1-500, default 50. Ids follow the order the app synced the rides, not the ride dates.
name: list_rides
title: List rides
